response_blind_node_rule.node_coordinate_rule: median Latitude and median Longitude across all response-independent deployment records for the stable node key
response_blind_node_rule.year_availability_rule: a node is available in a year when at least one deployment record for that stable node key has Survey_Nights > 0 in that year
response_blind_node_rule.within_year_multiple_deployments: aggregate availability; sum Survey_Nights only for audit/baseline effort and retain the stable node as one analysis node
response_blind_node_rule.repeated_node_definition: unique stable node keys available in at least two distinct outer years
response_blind_node_rule.closed_registry_rule: analysis registry is the union of stable node keys in the frozen deployment files after requiring finite WGS84 coordinates and valid outer-year membership; no sequence response is used to add, remove or merge nodes
